tasks.short: Study alternative courses of action and their outcomes.

steps.what: Score each alternative on the agreed measures.
Study outcomes the scores do not capture.
Choose the course of action with the best outcome.
Record which alternative was chosen and why.

tasks.design: Agreed measures are scored on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Outcomes the scores miss, and the choice of course, stay with the analyst. The record stores the choice and the reason, not a ranking presented as the decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Alternatives were scored in a sheet that hid which outcomes had no measure.
tasks.enabler_now: A measure with a formula can be scored again. The best outcome is not always the top score.
tasks.still_hard: An outcome the sponsor cares about that was never given a measure.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst says when the top score is the wrong plan.

ambition.what: The analyst decides, for each study, whether the top score is allowed to be the recommendation.

tasks.altitude: Scoring shrinks when measures exist. The choice stays. The analyst can reject a ranking that ignores an unscored outcome.

reach.task: Compare responses to an incident when not every harm has a number
reach.learn: How they record a reason that is not the top score

evidence.claim: Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.
A report assistant can answer questions on a prepared semantic model, and can misread a model that was not prepared.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from named alternatives and measures to a recorded choice. Carrying out the plan is out of scope.
Structured fields are alternative, measure, score and reason. The analyst names the measures. Fallback: an alternative with a missing measure is not given a total.
Test a {BI} score table before custom code. Do not let a chat pick the plan.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers measure formulas.
unknowns: Whether the measures are already agreed before alternatives are studied.
Who attends the choice, the analyst alone or with a manager.
research_questions: What share of alternatives can be fully scored?
How often is the chosen plan not the top score?

incremental.description: Maintain measure formulas used to score alternatives

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: measures are disputed and the study is mostly judgement. High case: scores refresh and the unscored outcomes plus the choice remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet senior managers to clarify objectives and problems.

steps.what: Prepare an objectives note from prior decisions.

loop.output: Objectives note: objective, owner, open problem
loop.check: Analyst deletes an objective that is not in a record
loop.stop: One pass; no record means no line
loop.why_not_simpler: Old decisions are notes, not a current objective

steps.what: Meet senior managers to clarify objectives and problems.
Record the objectives the managers confirmed.

tasks.design: A note is drafted only from prior decision records. The meeting with senior managers stays. The {PROJECT} record stores what they confirmed, and the analyst checks that the record matches the meeting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Objectives were restated from memory at the start of every meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Prior decisions can be listed. Clarifying what management wants now cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Managers who do not agree with each other.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst hears which objective is real.
tasks.altitude: The meetings stay. The analyst stops opening them by reconstructing the last decision.

reach.task: Confirm the objective with the sponsor before building
reach.learn: How they write down a conflict between two sponsors

evidence.claim: Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from prior decisions to a confirmed objective. Solving the problem is out of scope.
Structured fields are objective, owner and open problem. Prior records produce the draft; the meeting confirms them. Fallback: an unconfirmed objective is not filed as agreed.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours covers the note template.
unknowns: Whether prior decisions are already in a system or only in mail.
How many senior managers must agree.
research_questions: What share of meetings change the objective rather than confirm it?
How often do two managers name different problems?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: managers disagree and the meeting is the whole task. High case: the note is reused and only the meeting stays at full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Specify computational methods applied to the models.

steps.what: State the question the method must answer.
Specify computational methods applied to the models.
Configure the engine to run that method.
Check engine output against a known case.

tasks.design: The analyst states the question and specifies the computational method. The {DATA_PLATFORM} engine is configured to that method and checked on a known case. A model does not choose the method. The analyst signs the specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method was a paragraph in a notebook, and the first run was the first check.
tasks.enabler_now: An engine can compute a specified method. Choosing the method is the work.
tasks.still_hard: A known case that passes while the real question is different.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a simpler method is the honest one.

ambition.what: The analyst decides, before the run, which method is allowed for this question.

tasks.altitude: Setup and the known-case check shrink once the method is specified. The specification stays.

reach.task: Lock the statistical method before a programmer runs it
reach.learn: How they keep the method choice separate from the computation

evidence.claim: In a measured trial, a model picked the statistical test and an engine computed it. Sample-size accuracy was 94.1 percent versus 55.4 percent, taking 4.0 versus 9.3 minutes.
Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.
Article 4 has required AI literacy of staff since February 2025.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a decision question to a checked method. Interpreting a live study for a committee is out of scope.
Structured fields are question, method name, inputs and known-case result. The analyst specifies the method. The engine returns the number. Fallback: if the known case fails, the job is not reused.
Test the platform's existing statistical jobs before custom code. Do not let a model pick the test.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers job templates. The trial's accuracy figures are not this team's. Staff who touch the job need to know the engine, not the model, computes.
unknowns: Whether known cases already exist for the methods this team uses.
Who may change a method after the first run.
research_questions: What share of studies reuse a method rather than invent one?
How often does the known case fail?

incremental.description: Maintain engine jobs for specified methods

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each question needs a new method and the known case is weak. High case: the method is reused, the engine runs, and the analyst still signs the specification. A model does not select the test.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and conduct an experiment where existing data cannot.

steps.what: Design the experiment where existing data cannot answer.
Conduct the experimental run with the operating team.
Capture the experimental results in the file.
Evaluate the experimental model against those results.

tasks.design: The design and the experimental run stay with the analyst and the operating team. Results are captured in the {DATA_PLATFORM} from what was observed, not invented. Evaluation of whether the model is good enough stays a judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Experiments were designed in a document and the results lived in a private sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: A result file with the design's factors can be checked for missing runs. It cannot design the experiment.
tasks.still_hard: An operation that will not sit still for the design.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst sees when the run did not test the question.
tasks.altitude: Floor time stays. Filing results takes less retyping. The analyst can reject an evaluation that skips a planned run.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Run a test that the specification named, and record the actual result
reach.learn: How they mark a run that did not follow the plan

evidence.claim: An experiment is designed and run by people when existing data cannot answer the question.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. The operating team's time on the floor is included in the analyst's own conducting step, not double-counted. Boundary: from a data gap to an evaluation. Rolling the change into production is out of scope.
Structured fields are factor, level, run id and observation. The design names them; the run produces the observation. Fallback: a missing run stays missing.
Test a {DATA_PLATFORM} table for results before custom code.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the result table.
unknowns: Whether the operation can be experimented on, or only observed.
Who must approve stopping the line for a run.
research_questions: What share of questions truly have no existing data?
How often is a planned run skipped?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the operation is hard to interrupt and design plus the run are the whole task. High case: only capture shrinks. The experiment is not replaced by a model of missing data.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Choice meetings, manager meetings, method specification and experiments stay. Scoring and known-case checks take less time. The analyst can reject a top score or a failed known case.
reach: Clinical data managers lock a method before a run
Quality testers record a run that left the plan
skills_to_grow: Naming the method before the engine runs
Recording a reason that is not the top score
role.ambitious_version: The analyst spends the week on method, choice and experiments, with scores and known cases already computed.
